    - Every costume on the Row comes out of this attic. Forty-eight years now. I dressed [Lavinia](../npcs/lavinia.md) in the great parts and [Rosamund](../npcs/rosamund.md) in every part she's ever had.
    - I don't buy cloth, I haggle it. [Isabeau](../npcs/isabeau.md) at the **Crown Market** is the only person in the city I enjoy losing to.

    - Crispin's Balrog play. I've read enough to fret over the budget for the fourth act, and there isn't a fifth yet to fret over.
    - And the audiences go home earlier these days. The Row has never gone dark in my lifetime, dear. I'd like to keep it that way.
